subject: QBR NerveCore: launch readiness, OKR gaps & action plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR NerveCore: launch readiness, OKR gaps & action plan

Team —

We need a concise, leadership-ready status for the Product/Eng section of the QBR next Tuesday. Please use the attached NerveCore template to capture:
- Current engineering commitment dates for the three launch features (A, B, C)
- Remaining open-blocker count and owners
- Any OKR deltas that would materially affect launch vs our target ARR ramp
- Top 3 delivery risks with mitigations and rollback/fallback plan

Deliverable: populate the template and reply-all with a one-paragraph summary + the completed attachment by end-of-day Friday (May 14). I will synthesize for the exec pack.

Attachment: [Attachment: qbr_nervecore_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR NerveCore: launch readiness, OKR gaps & action plan

Jonas —

Quick summary (full template attached):
- Feature A (User-facing policy controls): committed for 2027-06-08; UI finalization in progress (3 UX bugs).
- Feature B (Model routing + cost-optimization policy): on track for 2027-06-15 but requires infra autoscale quota (INF-4827) — currently gating performance tests.
- Feature C (Private deploy onboarding): landing 2027-06-22; docs + installers lagging by ~2 sprints.

OKR delta: We are tracking a ~10% probability of slip for Feature B that would reduce projected Q3 revenue capture for targeted enterprise pilots; mitigation is prioritized testing and an emergency quota request to infra.

Top delivery risks:
1) Autoscale quota (owner: Karthik) — impact: degraded throughput & missed SLA for early customers. Mitigation: infra escalation + prioritized performance testing; fallback: temporary burst on Dedicated pool.
2) Installer regression on customer images (owner: Laura) — impact: delays in Private onboardings; mitigation: freeze non-critical installer changes + focused test matrix.
3) UX polish leading to scope creep (owner: Product PM) — mitigation: lock MVP scope; schedule post-launch polish.

Attachment: [Attachment: feature-readiness-matrix.csv (text/csv)]

Laura Bennett
VP Product
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR NerveCore: launch readiness, OKR gaps & action plan

On Tue, May 11, 2027 at 11:03 AM Laura Bennett wrote:
> Jonas —
> 
> Quick summary (full template attached):
> - Feature A ...

Adding engineering detail and constraints:
- Autoscale quota (INF-4827) is the real gating factor for Feature B perf runs; infra has acknowledged the request but lead capacity is constrained. I've opened an exec-level escalation with infra to get a temporary bump for the week of May 24.
- Current sprint velocity: we closed ~78% of planned story points last sprint due to higher-than-expected debugging time on quantized kernels. Expect normalizing by next sprint if no new infra issues appear.
- Risk table (short):
  * Risk: quantized kernel perf regression — Owner: S. Mehta — Mitigation: revert to prior kernel while we iterate on patch; Risk level: medium-high.
  * Risk: CI flakiness for private installer images — Owner: infra-cicd — Mitigation: isolate flaky tests and add gating; Risk level: medium.

Ask: if leadership can prioritize the infra quota escalation and approve a small Dedicated burst budget (estimate: $18k/week for 2 weeks) we can de-risk Feature B timing.

Karthik
Director of Engineering
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-14T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR NerveCore: launch readiness, OKR gaps & action plan

Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few directions from my side:
1) Approve the Dedicated burst for perf testing (up to $20k/week for two weeks) to unblock Feature B. Finance, please count this as Q2 engineering runway.
2) We need an explicit rollback/canary plan for Feature B. Karthik — please attach the canary playbook by EOD Monday.
3) Laura — hold any additional UX scope unless it demonstrably increases activation; we must protect the launch window.

I'll brief the exec growth pair on the potential OKR delta (10% upside risk) and the proposed runway spend. If we hit a hard blocker after May 24, we will consider a limited pilot for Acme to keep momentum.

Attachment: [Attachment: canary-playbook.md (text/markdown)]

Vivek Kulkarni
SVP Product & GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmecorp.com>, contracts@acmecorp.com
Date: 2027-05-18T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR NerveCore: launch readiness, OKR gaps & action plan

Folks —

Consolidated summary for the QBR exec pack (one-paragraph):
Product and Engineering remain aligned to the June launch window for NerveCore features A/B/C. Feature B performance runs are gated by an autoscale quota (INF-4827) and quantized kernel stability; we are approving a short Dedicated burst (up to $20k/week x2) to de-risk. Feature C installer polish requires two sprints of focused docs/QA; we will freeze non-critical installer changes. Net OKR impact: a manageable ~10% risk to projected pilot revenue if Feature B slips, with a clear mitigation path (quota bump + canary plan).

Action items (owners):
- Karthik: confirm quota approval and attach canary-playbook.md to the shared drive (due: 2027-05-19 12:00 PT).
- Laura: finalize the feature-readiness matrix and lock scope for Feature A (due: 2027-05-19 12:00 PT).
- Vivek: brief finance and exec growth on runway ask (complete).

I will include this paragraph and the artifacts in the QBR deck. Sarah/Acme — we will confirm pilot timeline after we validate the perf runs the week of May 24; I will follow up with you early next week with a firm date.

Attachments included in repo: qbr_nervecore_template.xlsx, feature-readiness-matrix.csv, canary-playbook.md

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
